items.text: The graph above shows the numbers of very hot days, defined as days with the highest daytime temperature reaching 35˚C or above, in six cities in 2023 and in 2024. <break time="0.8s" /> Among the six cities, Cairo showed a greater number of very hot days than any other city in 2023 and in 2024, respectively. <break time="0.8s" /> Beijing was the only city whose number of very hot days in 2024 was smaller than that in 2023 among the cities shown in the graph. <break time="0.8s" /> In 2024, the number of very hot days in Manila was greater than that in Rome. <break time="0.8s" /> Santiago had the smallest number of very hot days in 2023 as well as in 2024 among the cities above. <break time="0.8s" /> In Washington, D, C, the number of very hot days in 2024 was more than three times that in 2023.
